rows.answer:
The heaters on oxygen tank No. 2 ran on 65-volt ground power for about eight hours before launch to empty the tank [1]. The tank's thermostatic switches were built to a 1962 specification for 28 volts DC [2], and the heater specification was revised to 65 volts without the switches being changed [3].

North American revised the heater specification to 65 volts in 1965 [6], and Beech Aircraft did not change the switches when that specification moved [7].
